items.headline: North Hollywood haadsa: gaadi ne 3 ko kuchla
items.detail: Los Angeles ke North Hollywood me ek safed SUV metro station ke paas paidal chal rahe logon aur thele walon par chadh gayi; 3 log mare aur 3 gambhir roop se ghayal hue, haadse ki wajah abhi jaanch me hai.

items.headline: House ne Hegseth ke khilaf mahabhiyog roka
items.detail: America ki House ne 211-204 se raksha mantri Pete Hegseth ke khilaf mahabhiyog prastav ko committee ko bhej diya; Iran yuddh par aaropon par turant vote ab nahi hoga, Democrats January me phir koshish kar sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: America me mahabhiyog prakriya aur Iran yuddh par Congress ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran khatre par Bessent sainya base gaye
items.detail: America ke vitt mantri Scott Bessent kathit Iran khatre ke baad apne Washington ghar se sainya base chale gaye; vitt vibhaag ne kaha ve Iran ke khatron se dareinge nahi, khatre ki gambhirta abhi spasht nahi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanaav aur Iran par pratibandh abhiyan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi: badi kaidi adla-badli par charcha
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha Abu Dhabi vaarta me 1,000-1,000 ya 1,500-1,500 ke format me bade paimane par kaidi adla-badli par charcha hui; America ke pratinidhi is mudde par Russia se baat karenge, yuddhviram par abhi koi sahmati nahi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine shaanti vaarta aur kaidi adla-badli — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nvidia ne Wachtell ko jaanch saunpi
items.detail: Nvidia ne Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz ko CEO Jensen Huang ke kathit Chinese jasus se sambandh ki swatantra jaanch ke liye bulaya; FBI alag se jaanch kar raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Nvidia, AI chip aur rashtriya suraksha

items.headline: Trump ka BBC par maan-hani mukadma aage badhega
items.detail: Florida ke federal judge Jeffrey Kuntz ne BBC ki kharij karne ki arzi thukra di; Trump ka kehna hai BBC documentary ne 6 January 2021 ke bhashan ko tod-marod kar dikhaya, Florida kanoon wala daava kharij hua.
items.exam_angle: America me media-maan-hani mukadme — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kryvyi Rih par drone hamla, bijli-paani band
items.detail: Ukraine ke Kryvyi Rih me raat ko drone hamle se sheher ke ek hisse ki bijli gayi aur paani-garmi ki suvidha prabhavit hui; sheher ke raksha pramukh ke anusaar ghar, school aur kindergarten ko bhi nuksaan pahuncha.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me oorja par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Seoul ke paas bus haadsa, 57 ghayal
items.detail: Seongnam ke Bundang me subah ek city bus ne signal par khadi 32 gaadiyon ko takkar maari; 9 log gambhir roop se aur 48 halke ghayal hue, kisi ki jaan ko khatra nahi.

items.headline: Zelensky: Europe november tak pratinidhi chune
items.detail: Ukraine ke rashtrapati Zelensky ne kaha Europe ko November ke ant tak shanti vaarta ke liye apna pratinidhi chunna chahiye, behtar hoga 19 November ko Germany me hone wali Coalition of the Willing baithak me faisla ho.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine shanti vaarta me Europe ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Jail se UK airbase par hamle ki sajish
items.detail: America ne aarop lagaya ki New York ki jail se Iranian operative Mohammad Dawood Al-Saadi ne coded messages se UK ke RAF Fairford base par hamle ki sajish rachayi; do aur logon par bhi aarop lage.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanaav aur antarrashtriya suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UK me US sena adhikari jasusi me giraftar
items.detail: Britain me NATO unit me tainat 41 saal ke US sena adhikari ko Russia se judi jasusi ke sandeh me giraftar kiya gaya; woh London me hirasat me hai.
items.exam_angle: NATO aur Russian jasusi

items.headline: Houthi hamle: Riyadh me dhamake, missile roka gaya
items.detail: Houthi vidrohiyon ne Mangalvaar ko Riyadh airport aur Aramco suvidhaon par naye missile-drone hamle ka daava kiya; Saudi gathbandhan ne Riyadh ki ore aayi ballistic missile ko rok diya.
items.exam_angle: Yemen-Saudi sangharsh aur tel suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Norway ne data center grid roka
items.detail: Norway ke grid operator Statnett ne 9 November se naye data centers ke liye grid capacity reservation rok di; sarkar 2027 me licensing laayegi aur crypto mining ko prathamikta nahi degi.
items.exam_angle: AI data center aur oorja neeti — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO: $70-78 prati share, $1 trillion mulya
items.detail: Claude banane wali Anthropic ne IPO ke liye $70 se $78 prati share ka daam tay kiya; $64.4 billion tak jutakar company ka mulya lagbhag $1 trillion ho sakta hai — AI boom ki sabse badi pariksha.
items.exam_angle: AI boom aur duniya ke sabse bade IPO me se ek — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russia ki tel refining kshamata 30% giri
items.detail: Reuters ke anusaar October ke ant se Ukraine ke drone hamlo ne Russia ki tel shodhan kshamata lagbhag 30% ghata di; pichhle hafte 35 me se 9 badi refinery prabhavit hui aur Kirishi refinery me aag lagi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine oorja yuddh aur vaishvik tel bazaar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: China ne US sainikon ke avashesh saunpe
items.detail: Chengdu me hue samaroh me China ne America ko WWII ke Hump Route par laapata hue US vayu-sainikon ke avashesh saunpe; pehchan ke liye America me DNA jaanch hogi.
items.exam_angle: WWII ka Hump Route — itihaas ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UNICEF: Gaza me baadh ka khatra, marammat ruki
items.detail: UNICEF ne kaha Israel ne Gaza ke Sheikh Radwan basin ki marammat ke liye saaman ki aamad roki; bhaari baarish se hazaaron tent doob chuke hain aur ret ke teele girne se chaar log mare.

items.headline: America: mehngai 0.4% badhi, byaaj badhne ki ummeed
items.detail: America me October me mehngai 0.4% badhi aur core mehngai 0.3% rahi — ummeed se zyada; Fed December me byaaj badha sakta hai, aadha point bhi charcha me hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki mehngai aur Fed ki byaaj dar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UAE ke paani me ADNOC jahaz par hamla
items.detail: Arabian Gulf me UAE ke samudri kshetra me hamle ke baad ADNOC Logistics and Services ke ek jahaz ko nuksaan pahuncha; jahaz ki pehchan aur nuksaan ka vivaran abhi nahi diya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me samudri suraksha aur oorja vyaapaar par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Indonesia ke up-rashtrapati ne istifa ki peshkash ki
items.detail: Up-rashtrapati Gibran Rakabuming Raka ne Rashtrapati Prabowo se mulakaat me istife ki ichha jataayi; shiksha dastavezon par adalat ke faisle ke baad unki yogyata par sawal uth rahe hain, rashtrapati ne abhi faisla nahi liya.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia ki rajneeti aur up-rashtrapati ki yogyata vivaad — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Israel ki nayi Knesset ne shapath li
items.detail: October ke chunaav ke baad Israel ki 120 sadasya wali nayi Knesset ne shapath li; kisi gut ko bahumat nahi mila aur Gadi Eisenkot sarkar banane ki koshish kar rahe hain, Netanyahu karyavahak PM bane rahenge.
items.exam_angle: Israel ki rajneeti aur sarkar gathan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kohre me Bulgaria highway par 86 gaadiyan takrayin
items.detail: Bulgaria ki Trakia motorway par ghane kohre me do bade haadse hue — 86 gaadiyan takrayin, 12 log mare aur 46 ghayal hue.

items.headline: Senate ne shutdown khatm karne wala bill pass kiya
items.detail: America ki Senate ne Somvaar raat 60-40 se funding bill pass kiya — 41 din se chal raha sabse lamba shutdown khatm hone ke kareeb; ab Budhvaar shaam ko House me vote hoga.
items.exam_angle: America ka sabse lamba shutdown aur Congress ki funding prakriya — antarrashtriya sambandh aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi vaarta: pehla din kathin, aaj doosra din
items.detail: Ukraine-Russia-America vaarta ka pehla satra lagbhag 4 ghante chala; Kremlin ne ise 'kathin lekin rachnaatmak' bataya — suraksha guarantee aur oorja-yuddhviram par baatchit aaj 11 November ko phir shuru hogi.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shaanti vaarta aur suraksha guarantee — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
